baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exceptive placement of the Messiah as a messenger, followed by the messengers who passed before him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sonship fixes a human genealogy, messenger names a carried office, and passing-before orders its bearers into a temporal series. The claim is therefore a category placement inside a successive human chain, not merely a negation.

activation_trace.role: Sonship as lineage and attribution supplies the human genealogical coordinate.
Messenger and carried message define the office shared by the singular and plural bearers.
Passing generations place officeholders under temporal succession and departure.
Temporal precedence orders the earlier messengers relative to the Messiah.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply denies an elevated claim and mentions earlier messengers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah reclassifies the Messiah within a genealogically human and temporally successive messenger office.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: His mother was a steadfast truthful woman; the two of them used to eat food.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mother-son relation identifies an embodied pair, the past-state construction makes eating an occurring condition, and food is livelihood taken in. Their shared intake functions as an observable dependence test.

activation_trace.role: Motherhood as bearing and nurture establishes the second member of the embodied pair.
Established truth and completed rectitude give the mother an honored but creaturely role.
Occurrence in time turns eating from an abstract capacity into their lived condition.
Literal taking of nourishment supplies the bodily dependency.
Food as provision and livelihood identifies what must come to the pair from outside themselves.

changed_reading.before: Eating is an incidental biographical detail.
changed_reading.after: Their dual, temporally realized intake is a compact empirical test of embodied dependence on provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Look how the signs are made clear, then look from where or how they are turned away.
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled command establishes two inspections: first the production of visible meaning, then the directional reversal that follows it. Clear signs and failed uptake are held together without treating lack of evidence as the cause of refusal.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight frames both clarification and deflection as inspectable processes.
Emergence into visibility supplies the clarity side of the contrast.
The sign as a manifest marker gives observation an evidentiary object.
Questioning place, direction, condition, or manner makes the second inspection diagnostic.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies the reversal despite clarity.

changed_reading.before: The final commands merely emphasize that the audience is mistaken.
changed_reading.after: The ending stages a two-step inquiry into how evidence becomes clear and how reception is nevertheless redirected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated eating of illicit gain makes ingestion a social and moral act of appropriation, while the focus pair eat unqualified food. Ordinary dependence and corrupt consumption become two different ways bodies participate in a material economy.

activation_trace.role: Literal nourishment anchors the focus clause in ordinary embodied intake.
Consumption as taking or exhausting wealth turns eating into an economic act.
Illicit and defective gain morally qualifies what the earlier eaters incorporate.
The repeated wealth-consuming image makes the economic reading persistent rather than incidental.
The repeated illicit object sharpens the contrast with the focus ayah's plain food.

structural_cues: 5:62-63 repeat the same eating-plus-illicit-gain construction before 5:75 substitutes unqualified food.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated corrupt consumption and later ordinary eating; I infer a contrast through root recurrence. A live alternative is that 5:75 invokes only biological dependence, without recalling the earlier moral economy.

changed_reading.before: The pair's eating proves only that they have bodies.
changed_reading.after: Their plain nourishment locates them in the material economy of receivers while distinguishing ordinary dependence from the pericope's corrupt appropriation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine expenditure and food available from above and below establish an outward flow of provision. Because the Messiah and his mother eat provision, the focus clause places them on the receiving side of that flow.

activation_trace.role: Taking nourishment marks the pair as recipients.
Food as livelihood names the provision received.
The outward movement of expenditure supplies the provider side of the relation.
Eating as one's apportioned provision directly links intake to supplied sustenance.
Provision from an upper direction gives the supply field a vertical extent.
Provision from beneath completes the encompassing field from which eaters receive.

structural_cues: 5:64 presents divine spending, and 5:66 presents eating supplied from above and below, before 5:75 identifies the pair as eaters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expenditure, vertically sourced eating, and the pair's intake; I infer a provider-to-recipient arrow. A live alternative is that 5:64-66 describe communal abundance without specifying the focus pair's provider relation.

changed_reading.before: Eating is a generic marker of creatureliness.
changed_reading.after: Eating places the pair at the recipient end of the pericope's provision flow, opposite the source that expends and supplies.

context_deltas.mechanism: What descends is delivered to a messenger, the messenger must bring it to its destination, and prophetic judgment later travels on a tongue. This forms a source-carrier-audience relay that specifies the focus title as mediation rather than origination.

activation_trace.role: The messenger as bearer of a message anchors the focus figure inside a relay role.
Messenger and message are explicitly paired, exposing the office-content distinction.
Delivering a message to its destination supplies the carrier-to-audience leg.
Sending something down and making it arrive supplies the upstream source-to-carrier leg.
The tongue as an instrument for delivering a message makes prophetic voicing a conduit.

structural_cues: 5:67 spells out descent, messenger, and delivery; 5:78 attributes judgment to the tongues of David and Jesus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the relay stages; I infer that their role grammar sharpens the same messenger title in 5:75. A live alternative is that the tongue construction marks attribution only, without foregrounding mediation.

changed_reading.before: Messenger is chiefly a rank assigned to the Messiah.
changed_reading.after: Messenger is a constrained relay office: received content is voiced and delivered, distinguishing bearer from source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger series repeatedly collides with audience desire and branches into denial or killing. The focus statement that messengers passed now evokes not a placid chronology but an exposed office whose mortal bearers can be violently refused.

activation_trace.role: Generational passing supplies the focus chain's mortality and departure.
Successive dispatch and repeated messenger arrival make the chain recur encounter by encounter.
The inclination of desire supplies the audience-side force opposing the delivered content.
Assigning the messenger or message to falsehood supplies one mode of rejection.
Taking life supplies the terminal bodily mode of rejection.

structural_cues: 5:70 uses a repeated whenever-pattern and divides the messengers into denied and killed groups before 5:75 recalls those who passed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent rejection and later generational passing; I infer that the former gives vulnerability to the latter. It does not license inferring that every messenger's passing, or the Messiah's, was killing.

changed_reading.before: Earlier messengers simply belong to the past.
changed_reading.after: Their passing belongs to a recurrent, mortal messenger chain exposed to desire-driven denial and violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Messiah directs worship to the Lord shared by speaker and audience, partnership is excluded by divine oneness, and worship is tested against ownership of harm and benefit. The focus pair's need to eat becomes one observable relation in this larger audit of who receives, who rules, and who owns outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Taking nourishment supplies an observable need on the recipient side.
Submissive worship identifies the relation the Messiah directs away from himself.
Lordship as ownership and sovereignty identifies the shared ruler of speaker and audience.
Associating a partner with God names the category error under examination.
Divine oneness without partner fixes the exclusive source side of the audit.
Possession with power of disposal supplies the criterion of effective agency.
Capacity over loss or injury supplies the negative outcome under the ownership test.
Capacity over benefit supplies the positive outcome under the ownership test.

structural_cues: 5:72-73 state worship, shared lordship, partnership, and oneness immediately before the focus; 5:76 follows with an ownership-of-effects test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship direction, sovereign ownership, outcome control, and bodily intake; I infer a relational agency test joining them. A live alternative is that 5:76 targets worship objects generally and does not use food-dependence as its criterion.

changed_reading.before: Eating demonstrates that the Messiah and his mother are human.
changed_reading.after: Eating is one input in a wider agency audit distinguishing the provision-needing worshipper from the sovereign owner of outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus looks backward to earlier messengers, while 5:77 looks backward to people already astray whose desires are followed. The past therefore offers rival transmissions: commissioned message-bearing succession and desire-driven path dependence.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence opens the focus ayah's backward line toward earlier messengers.
Successive groups supply the legitimate form of continuity through time.
Following as allegiance and succession supplies the mechanism of inherited orientation.
The inclination of desire supplies what is transmitted in the rival lineage.
Repeated departure from guidance supplies both inherited and propagated misdirection.
The second temporal-before phrase opens the backward line toward prior error.

structural_cues: The same temporal root marks messengers before the Messiah in 5:75 and people astray before the audience in 5:77.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two backward temporal lines and explicit following; I infer that they contrast forms of inheritance. A live alternative is that the repeated before is ordinary chronology without a designed opposition.

changed_reading.before: Before him only dates the Messiah relative to prior messengers.
changed_reading.after: Before him locates him in one of two competing pasts: messenger succession rather than inherited desire and misdirection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated blindness and deafness close the sensory routes; later hearing leads through eyes, overflow, and recognition of truth; denial of signs closes the sequence. The focus's doubled look is therefore the hinge of a reception fork, not a guarantee that visibility compels assent.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight anchors the focus invitation to receive evidence.
Manifest clarity establishes that the evidence side of the encounter is open.
Directional reversal supplies the failed branch after evidence is exposed.
Repeated loss of sight supplies closure of the visual route.
Repeated loss of hearing and refusal to listen supply closure of the auditory route.
Hearing as understanding and response opens the receptive branch.
The seeing eye transfers auditory reception into a visible bodily response.
Easy abundant overflow makes reception exceed inward cognition and become observable.
Recognition by a trace or sign supplies the successful uptake of evidence.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies what recognition reaches.
The manifest sign returns as the object explicitly denied, closing the failed branch.

structural_cues: 5:71 repeats blindness and deafness, 5:75 repeats looking, 5:83 sequences hearing through recognition and tears, and 5:86 ends with denied signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting sensory-response chains; I infer that they frame the focus's doubled look as a fork in reception. A live alternative is that these scenes contrast communities broadly rather than diagramming one local epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Looking at clear signs should straightforwardly correct error.
changed_reading.after: The double look exposes a fork: manifest signs can be recognized into embodied witness or met by sensory closure and directional reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later receptive sequence moves from recognizing truth to settled belief and public witness. That sequence expands the mother's title from a static honorific into a compact response-role: truth is recognized, inwardly confirmed, and borne outwardly.

activation_trace.role: Completed rectitude and stable truth anchor the mother's response-role.
Recognition through a sign supplies the first movement toward confirmed truth.
Truth as stable correspondence supplies the content recognized.
Heart-settling confirmation supplies inward assent to recognized truth.
Testimony that states knowledge supplies the outward completion of the response.

structural_cues: The focus names the mother by intensive truthfulness; 5:83 later unfolds recognition, belief, speech, and requested inclusion among witnesses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truth-title and a later response sequence; I infer that the sequence unpacks the title's function. A live alternative is that the title honors the mother independently of the later receptive group.

changed_reading.before: The mother's title is an isolated commendation beside the Messiah's title.
changed_reading.after: Her title models the truthful reception that the pericope later unfolds as recognition, settled belief, and testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material branch of the son-root rather than the surface lineage sense. It remains anchored because that branch explicitly images food building flesh and the same ayah explicitly joins sonship to eating food. Render it only as a lexical-material resonance, not as the direct lexical meaning of son.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The son designation and the later statement that the pair ate food.

activation_trace.role: Food building flesh supplies a material construction image latent beside the son designation.
Literal eating provides the intake by which embodied material is maintained.
Taking and tasting food supplies the material incorporated into the body.

changed_reading.before: Sonship gives genealogy, and eating separately proves bodily need.
changed_reading.after: A branch-level resonance links them: the son's embodied form is materially sustained and built through the food he takes in.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface verb uses the passing sense of the root while the exception sense is a neighboring lexical branch. It remains anchored because the ayah itself places that verb beside an explicit not-but exception construction. Render it as possible rhetorical resonance, not as an alternate parse of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The not-but restriction to messenger immediately followed by the statement that earlier messengers passed.

activation_trace.role: Passing and departure supply the temporal emptying of successive officeholders.
Excluding an exception from a general judgment resonates with the ayah's explicit not-but restriction.
Successive groups of messengers connect categorical restriction to temporal replacement.

changed_reading.before: The categorical restriction and the passing of messengers are adjacent but independent claims.
changed_reading.after: The wording may stage a double emptying: the exception confines the predicate to messenger, while passing vacates each temporal bearer of that office.

strongest_changes: Eating changed from a generic proof of embodiment into both a provider-recipient topology and, more cautiously, a contrast between ordinary nourishment and corrupt appropriation.
Messenger changed from a title into a relay office carried by vulnerable, successive human bearers.
The doubled look changed from emphasis into the hinge of a reception fork between recognition and deflection.
Temporal precedence changed from simple dating into a contrast between messenger succession and inherited desire-driven error.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made bodily intake, message transmission, temporal inheritance, and sensory reception converge on one category test without collapsing them into a single reading. The most unusual focus-only activations were food building flesh within the son-root inventory and the exception resonance beside the passing verb.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the repeated eating root intentionally contrasts illicit gain with the pair's ordinary food.
Whether the two backward temporal lines are designed as rival inheritances or merely share ordinary chronology.
Whether the exception branch beside the passing verb is rhetorically live or accidental lexical proximity.
Whether the sensory scenes diagram the focus ayah's local reception mechanism or only a broader contrast among groups.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Eating makes dependence perceptible at the body.** `ء ك ل B001` is ingestion and `ط ع م B004` provision/livelihood. The doctrinal claim is answered by ordinary intake. I infer that recurring need materially distinguishes messenger and mother from the source that provisions them.
2. **Directed looking exposes directional inversion.** `ن ظ ر B001` directs sight/insight, `ب ي ن B005` discloses by sign, and `ء ف ك B001` turns from proper direction. Repeated “look” brackets clarification and diversion. I infer that the signs are clear enough for the remaining puzzle to be the mechanism of turning.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Eating supplies a material dependence test.** Fixed **ء ك ل / B001** (“ingesting food”) is deliberately predicated of both Messiah and mother after messengerhood and truthfulness are affirmed. 5:72–5:73 concern divine identity and numerical composition; 5:76 immediately asks whether what lacks independent harm or benefit can be worshipped. I infer that recurring intake reveals bodies sustained by provision outside themselves. “They both ate food” therefore reads as causal evidence of creaturely dependence, not an incidental biographical detail.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:76 supplied the decisive follow-up: bodily intake is not merely creaturely resemblance but evidence that the worshipped object lacks independent control of harm and benefit.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin geçim ve kazanç bakımından iyi durumda veya payına düşen gelir bakımından talihli olması; ayrıca bol yiyecek sunması ya da bir gelir kaynağının birine geçim payı olarak ayrılması.

Bir kazanç yolu, arazi geliri, vergi payı veya kamu gelirinin birine geçim kaynağı olarak ayrılması.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bakışı ya da zihinsel dikkati bir şeye yönelterek onu görme, inceleme ve üzerinde düşünme çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Görsel bakma ile düşünsel inceleme aynı dikkat yöneltme temelinde buluşur; inceleme sonunda edinilen bilgi ise çekirdeğin sonucu olarak kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hem yalın ad ve biçimleri hem de bir şeye bakma ile bir konuyu inceleme yapılarının ayrı kapsamlarını korur; yapıya bağlı düşünme anlamı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözü ya da zihinsel dikkati bir şeye yönelterek onu görmeye, anlamaya veya ayrıntılı biçimde incelemeye çalışma; inceleme sonunda bilgi edinme bu sürecin sonucu olabilir.

facets.statement: Görme ya da anlama amacıyla göz veya zihinsel dikkat bir nesneye yöneltilir.
Gözle bakma, nesneyi doğrudan görme ve göz önünde inceleme biçiminde gerçekleşir.
Bir konu üzerinde düşünme, onu araştırma ve sonuçlarını tartma biçiminde zihinsel olarak gerçekleşir.
Dikkatli incelemenin ardından elde edilen bilgi, yöneltilmiş incelemenin sonucu olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gözle görme ile zihin yoluyla düşünme ve incelemeyi ortak bir dikkat yöneltme alanında birleştirir. Araştırma sonrasında oluşan bilgi, eylemin kendisi değil onun olası sonucudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Görsel ya da zihinsel dikkatin bir şeye yöneltilmesini birlikte anlatan en kısa genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkati yöneltme, görme ve inceleme çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözün bir nesneye yöneltildiği ve nesnenin görülüp incelendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نظر العين إلى الشيء ومعاينته، والنظر في الأمر بالتأمل والفحص والتدبر، والمشاهدة والاعتبار حيث نص المصدر عليها.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تأمل الشيء ومعاينته؛ نظرت إلى الشيء إذا عاينته (maqayis)؛ النظر تأمل الشئ بالعين (sihah)؛ نظر العين ونظر القلب؛ نظرت في الأمر احتمل أن يكون تفكرا وتدبرا بالقلب (tahdhib)؛ تقليب البصر والبصيرة لإدراك الشيء ورؤيته؛ التأمل والفحص؛ المعرفة الحاصلة بعد الفحص؛ مشاهدون؛ تعتبرون (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نظرته بمعنى انتظرته، وانتظر وأنظر وأخر وأمهل، والاسم النظرة والإنظار، وتوقع الفضل.

branches.branch_image_ar: تواجه الأشياء حتى يرى بعضها بعضا
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحي المتجاور الذي يرى بعضه بعضا، والدور المتحاذية أو المتناظرة، وما يقال في الطريق إذا قابل الجبل السالك.

branches.branch_image_ar: ظهور الشيء للناظر أو حسن مرآه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المنظر والمنظرة بمعنى المرأى أو الهيئة التي تعجب أو تسوء، وحسن المنظر، وإبداء الأرض نباتها.
يدخل فيه التعبير المجازي أن الدهر نظر إلى قوم فأهلكهم أو خانهم.
يدخل فيه النظير بمعنى المثل والند، والنظائر لاشتباه الأشياء، وما يجعل نظيرا لشيء آخر.
يدخل فيه النظرة كاللمحة بالعجلة، وبه نظرة أي شحوب، وإصابة عين من الجن، والقبح أو العيب، والهيبة حيث صرحت بها المصادر.
يدخل فيه الناظر في المقلة، سواد العين أو النقطة السوداء، وإطلاق الناظرة على العين، والناظران عرقان في مجرى الدمع.
يدخل فيه الناظر والناطور حافظ الكرم، والرقيب في المنظرة، والأمين المبعوث ليستبرئ أمر جماعة، ومن ينظر بملء عينيه بريئا من التهمة.
يدخل فيه ناظره والمناظرة، وأن ينظر اثنان في أمر كيف يأتيانه، والمباحثة والمباراة في النظر.
يدخل فيه النظرة بمعنى الرحمة، ونظر الله إلى عباده بمعنى الإحسان وإفاضة النعم كما نصت المصادر.

branches.branch_image_ar: نظر الحائر الذي لا يغني شيئا
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استعمال النظر في التحير في الأمور، والنظر الذي يدل على قلة الغناء أو عدم الإبصار النافع.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi tersine çevirip olması gereken yönünden uzaklaştırmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Bir kimseyi bir işten, iyilikten, inançtan veya doğrudan yalan ve batıl aracılığıyla uzaklaştırma bu çekirdeğin kişi ve amaç alanındaki özelleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel çevirme çekirdeğini korur; birini belirli bir şeyden uzaklaştırma anlamını ise yalnızca ilgili yapıya bağlı bir özelleşme olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tersine çevirerek olması gereken yönünden uzaklaştırmak veya başka bir yöne sevk etmektir. Kişi nesne olduğunda, onu bir amaçtan, iyilikten, inançtan ya da doğrudan alıkoyup batıla yöneltmeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir şey tersine çevrilir ve ait olduğu ya da yönelmesi gereken doğrultudan uzaklaştırılır.
Kişiye yönelik kullanımda kişi bir amaçtan, iyilikten, inançtan veya doğrudan alıkonup başka yöne sevk edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, tersine çevirme ile doğru ya da beklenen yönden uzaklaştırmayı birleştirir; kişiyi doğrudan veya iyilikten yalan ve batılla uzaklaştırma bunun özel görünümüdür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem nesnenin yönünü tersine çevirme çekirdeğini hem de kişinin amaç veya doğrultusundan uzaklaştırılmasını birlikte karşılar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin veya işin beklenen doğrultusundan çevrilmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi kendi yönünden uzaklaştırma işlemini bağlam içinde tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın hakikatten, inançtan veya iyilikten uzaklaştırıldığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin doğru kabul edilen amaç veya doğrultudan uzaklaştırılması özelleşmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, nesneyi tersine çevirmeyi ve kişiyi bir amaçtan etkin biçimde uzaklaştırmayı birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, öznenin yoldan veya doğrudan kendiliğinden sapmasını ve eğriliği de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da doğru veya beklenen yönden uzaklaşma ve uzaklaştırma alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda başka bir şeyi çeviren ya da saptıran bir etki öne çıkar; komşu dalda ise genel yön değişmesi, yoldan sapma ve eğrilik daha geniş bir alan oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, insanı hakikatten, inançtan veya iyilikten uzaklaştırma özelleşmesine sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, fiziksel bükme ve burma işlemlerini ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesne, yüz, kişi veya düşünceyi bulunduğu yönden çevirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırt edici yanı tersine çevirme ve amaçtan saptırmadır; komşu dalın ayırt edici yanı ise bükme ve burma hareketidir.
